title: Picture-Word Interference Dataset
description: This dataset comprises MEG (CTF), structural MRI, and behavioural data from 30 healthy young adults performing a picture-word interference (PWI) task, collected at the Rotman Research Institute, Baycrest Hospital, Toronto, Canada. Participants covertly named pictures while ignoring auditory distractor words that were phonologically related, semantically related, or unrelated to the picture name, judging whether the retrieved name ended in a target sound. The dataset supports research into lexical access and language production processes using MEG source localization informed by individual structural MRIs.
methods_description: Each subject completed 3 runs of the picture-word interference task, with 120 trials per run balanced across picture-word conditions (phonologically related, semantically related, unrelated). Behavioural reaction time and accuracy were recorded. MEG data (CTF system) were epoched to picture onset and response onset for event-related analyses, and each subject underwent structural MRI acquisition for MEG source localization.
